description.value: House of Boateng is a celebrated brunch and dinner café in Langford, BC, founded by Chef Castro and Charlotte Boateng, and named Best Brunch Spot by YAM Magazine in both 2024 and 2025. The kitchen emphasizes locally sourced ingredients from Island farmers, fishers, and foragers, with a menu spanning creative brunch dishes to elevated dinners. A take-home retail line of house-made sauces, spreads, and pre-prepared meals makes it equally useful for cyclists wanting to stock up for the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms this is an active, award-winning brunch and dinner café in Langford, BC. The contact page confirms the café phone (+1-778-432-2233) and address (105-2854 Peatt Road, Langford, BC), matching OSM tags. The website mentions a 'HOB Fine Food Take Home' line with 'take and bake' products confirming takeout availability, but no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Victoria' but the business is physically located in Langford, BC — a separate municipality in the Capital Regional District. Address has been updated to the website-confirmed value (105-2854 Peatt Road, Langford, BC).
